impact_assessment.why: ADR-186 fits a covered interaction, but behaviour outside the training range was untested and a magnitude-invariant rule can hide behind a scale-sensitive feature map
impact_assessment.benefits: separates capacity from representation: with world, coverage, sample count and learner fixed, only the feature map decides transfer (1.0 vs 0.5)
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new optional rule and feature_mode parameters, an extra rule kwarg on helpers; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: none; state: per-key counts only
impact_assessment.mitigation: both parameters default to the shipped values; the ablation differs in one argument; probability saturation reported so a confident-looking wrong readout cannot be cited
